sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS gmv FROM orders WHERE status IN ('paid','refunded') AND create_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND create_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01'
mistake: 用下单时间代替支付时间归期

sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS net_gmv FROM orders WHERE status IN ('paid','refunded') AND pay_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND pay_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01'

SELECT CAST(create_time AS DATE) AS stat_date, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS gmv FROM orders WHERE status IN ('paid','refunded') AND create_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND create_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
mistake: 用下单时间代替支付时间归期

sql: SELECT u.city AS city, ROUND(SUM(o.amount), 2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','refunded') AND o.create_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND o.create_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY gmv DESC
mistake: 用下单时间归期 + 未处理 city 为空

sql: SELECT rf.reason, ROUND(SUM(rf.refund_amount), 2) AS refund_amount FROM refunds rf JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = rf.order_id WHERE o.pay_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND o.pay_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY refund_amount DESC
mistake: 退款按订单支付时间归期，而不是退款发生时间

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS new_users FROM orders WHERE create_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND create_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01'
mistake: 把下单用户当成新增注册用户

sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pay_time IS NOT NULL THEN order_id END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 0), 4) AS pay_conversion_rate FROM orders WHERE pay_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND pay_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01'
mistake: 转化率按支付时间归期，而不是下单时间

sql: SELECT u.is_vip, ROUND(SUM(o.amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id), 0), 2) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','refunded') AND o.pay_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND o.pay_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
mistake: 客单价分母用人数而不是订单数

sql: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(i.unit_price * i.quantity), 2) AS item_amount FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','refunded') AND o.pay_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND o.pay_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY item_amount DESC, p.product_name LIMIT 5
mistake: 明细金额没有减去折扣（折扣前金额）

sql: SELECT channel, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND create_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS gmv_sep, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND create_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS gmv_aug FROM orders WHERE status IN ('paid','refunded') AND create_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND create_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY gmv_sep DESC
mistake: 用下单时间代替支付时间归期
